commentary_sources.H4/H5/H11/H12: 孔穎達《周易正義》繫辭上 卷七之四、七之五、七之十一、七之十二（韓康伯注 is the unmarked text after each base sentence; [疏] is 孔疏): sources/civilization-thought-v1.0/evidence/texts/YWH-H4.txt, YWH-H5.txt, YWH-H11.txt, YWH-H12.txt (H4, H11 also in sources/chinese-classical-texts/yidao-v1.3/evidence/texts/)

commentary_sources.coverage: 韩注/孔疏 in the repository cover only XCS-04-004..XCS-07-004 and XCS-11-011..XCS-12-021; nothing for 繫辭下. sources/zhouyi-yizhuan/commentary/ holds 周易正義/10 (序卦) and 外传卷五 only, not 韩/孔 on 繫辭. Units outside coverage have commentary none; one memory-based gloss is marked 待核 (XCS-01-008).

most_important.why: 生生之謂易: 孔疏 “後生次於前生” = 续而复生 (§4.6), and “故云生不云死” shows the choice of 生 is evaluative (exhortation); 神 := 陰陽不測 matches §4.6 神; 韩 “化之無主” = no external agent
一闔一闢謂之變: the plan's 一X一Y = 交替; 乾坤 as two movements of one door (相合)
往來不窮謂之通: relation + converse + 不尽; a second definition of 通 at XCS-12-013
形而上/下: 孔疏 相分 (先道而後形) against 外传 相合 (上下皆名也，天下惟器); 變 := 化而裁之 is a second definition of 變 (a cut of continuous 化)
一陰一陽之謂道: no commentary in the repository reads 一X一Y here as alternation (韩/孔: 一 = 无; 外传: 主持而分剂); 繼之者善 ties continuation to 善 (外传 “繼之則善矣，不繼則不善矣”)
窮則變，變則通，通則久: the plan's 丙一 example; the chain ends in 久 (continuation conditioned on 通); no counterexample in the corpus
困，窮而通: the plan's counterexample is not one (困 彖 “困而不失其所，亨”, hexagrams/47.json)
乾坤毀則无以見易，易不可見則乾坤或幾乎息: two-way dependence, the 相须 shape (§4.5); 息 = ceasing
日月相推而明生: alternation at the fine grain gives a coarser thing; one relation at two grains (§4.6)
寒暑相推而歲成: as XCX-04-004; 歲 as a coarse unit of an alternation
物相雜，故曰文: definition of 文 by 相 X; bears on 成文 (§三)
同功而異位: same under one class, different under another (§一 class-relativity), in the text's own words
天下之動，貞夫一者也: all motion constant to the one; cf. §4.3 四相无自立 under the class 一 (no commentary in repo)
動靜有常，剛柔斷矣: textual source of the word 有常, read alone a 丙一; plan §5.4 registers it as 相分
精氣為物，遊魂為變: 韩 聚極則散; 孔疏 變 = 死, 敗 or 變為異類 (亡 and 异 relative to a class)
上下无常……不可為典要，唯變所適, read with XCX-07-005 既有典常: no fixed rule for the moves, a constant canon for the reading
幾者，動之微: definition of the slight onset, readable before the coarse change
易有太極，是生兩儀: 韩 有必始於無 (相分-leaning) against 外传 非別有一太極 (相合)
變通者，趣時者也: 变通 defined through time
井，居其所而遷: continuation under the class of place, change under another
剛柔相推而生變化: the text's own “Z 而 Y 生” form with 相 X
貴賤之等: 戊 (爻有等, §5.4)
爻有等，故曰物: 甲 by form, registered 相分 (plan lists under 戊)
原始要終以為質: the book takes the start and end of a course as its matter
天地之大德曰生: 生 = production of things, not §4.3 生; polysemy to keep apart

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §4.2 (一 X 一 Y = 交替)
contradictions_and_strains.point: supported by 一闔一闢 and 一寒一暑, but for 一陰一陽 韩/孔 read 一 as 无 (道 beyond 阴阳) and 外传 as 主持而分剂; the operation is not uniform across the 一X一Y sentences

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §三 丙一 example (穷则变，反例：困，穷而通)
contradictions_and_strains.point: 而 marks sequence or concession and 困 彖 reads 困而不失其所，亨: 通 = 亨 kept by keeping one's place, compatible with 窮→變→通; a counterexample would need 窮 without 變. None found in 繫辭

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §5.2 (王夫之《周易外传》卷五, 待核)
contradictions_and_strains.point: both lines are in the repository: “萬變之理，相類相續而後成乎其章” (waizhuan-5.json, 第1章) and “繼之則善矣，不繼則不善矣” (第5章); 外传 also reads 不相繼 of 念 and 事 as the origin of 恶. Continuation is valued positively here, opposite to 起信论 (相续 = 无明, §5.4): the corpus evaluates continuation both ways, which supports keeping 续 neutral in the grammar and the evaluation apart

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §5.4 (形而上下与道器, registration by commentary)
contradictions_and_strains.point: 孔疏 is 相分 (凡有從無而生，先道而後形), 外传 相合 (上下皆名也，道者器之道); the registration depends on the commentary chosen

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §5.4 (动静有常 registered with 天尊地卑 as 相分)
contradictions_and_strains.point: read alone the unit is a conditional with the text's own 有常 as condition; the text's 有常 (of 动静) differs from the plan's (a class under 缘)
孔疏 supports 生生 as continuation and recurrence but states that 易 names 生 and not 死 for exhortation: the term already carries an evaluative selection; 天地之大德曰生 uses 生 as production
the text's 理 is order (天下之理) or a verb (韩: 事之所以理); the nearest support for 理 through classes and continuations is 外传 (相類相續而後成乎其章), a commentary
神 := 陰陽不測 matches the plan; 神 := 利用出入民咸用之 is a second sense in the same text
